messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#define rep(i, a, b) for (int i = a; i <= b; i++)
using namespace std;
const int N = 300010;
int n, K, mod;
int dp[N][20];
int cnt[N], mx[N];
int cj[N], inv[N];

int power(int x, int y) {
	int ret = 1;
	for (; y; y >>= 1, x = (int)(1LL * x * x % mod)) {
		if (y & 1) ret = (int)(1LL * ret * x % mod);
	}
	return ret;
}

int C(int i, int j) {
	return (int)(1LL * cj[i] * inv[j] % mod * inv[i - j] % mod);
}

int main() {
	cin >> n >> K >> mod;
	int i, j, k, ans = 0, down, up, tmp, now, cur1, cur2;
	if (n & 1) { cout << power(K, n) << endl; return 0; }
	cj[0] = 1;
	rep(i, 1, n) cj[i] = (int)(1LL * cj[i - 1] * i % mod);
	inv[n] = power(cj[n], mod - 2);
	inv[0] = 1;
	rep(i, n - 1, 0) inv[i] = (int)(1LL * inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod);
	rep(i, 1, n) {
		rep(j, 0, 18) if (1 << j & i) cnt[i]++;
	}
	rep(i, 1, n) {
		for (j = 18; j >= 0; j--) if (1 << j & i) mx[i] = 1 << j, break;
	}
	dp[0][0] = 1;
	rep(i, 1, n) {
		if ((n & i) != i) continue;
		now = i ^ mx[i];
		for (k = now; k >= 0; k = (k - 1) & now) {
			cur1 = k + mx[i];
			cur2 = i ^ cur1;
			up = min(K - 1, cnt[cur2]);
			tmp = C(i, cur1);
			rep(j, 0, up) dp[i][j + 1] = (dp[i][j + 1] + 1LL * dp[cur2][j] * tmp) % mod;
			if (k == 0) break;
		}
	}
	rep(j, 1, min(cnt[n], K)) ans = (ans + 1LL * dp[n][j] * C(K, j) % mod * cj[j]) % mod;
	ans = (power(K, n) - ans + mod) % mod;
	cout << ans << endl;
	return 0;
}
